title.zh: 【Velodrome 与 Aerodrome 定于 10 月 21 日升级为 Aero，xVELO 须于 10 月 15 日前跨回 OP】 Foresight
title.en: 【Velodrome 与 Aerodrome 定于 10 月 21 日升级为 Aero，xVELO 须于 10 月 15 日前跨回 OP】 Foresight

current_state.zh: Velodrome 与 Aerodrome 将于 10 月 21 日合并为统一跨链 DEX Aero；AERO、VELO 代币将并入单一 AERO，并按约 94.5%/5.5% 分配收入；上线网络覆盖 Base、以太坊主网、OP、Arc、Ink、Robinhood Chain 与 Arbitrum；社区和交易平台向 Aero 迁移，相关代币价格大涨。
current_state.en: Velodrome and Aerodrome are set to merge into unified cross-chain DEX Aero on October 21; AERO and VELO tokens will consolidate into a single AERO with revenue split roughly 94.5%/5.5%; launch coverage includes Base, Ethereum mainnet, OP, Arc, Ink, Robinhood Chain, and Arbitrum; community and exchanges are migrating to Aero, with token prices surging.

updates.what_changed_zh: Velodrome 和 Aerodrome 将于 10 月 21 日合并为统一 DEX「Aero」，在 OP 主网和 Ink 上线，xVELO 持有者须在 10 月 15 日前跨链回 OP，其他九个网络上的 gauge、排放和跨链支持将关停。
updates.what_changed_en: Velodrome and Aerodrome will merge into a unified DEX 'Aero' on Oct 21 launching on OP mainnet and Ink, with xVELO holders required to bridge back to OP by Oct 15 and gauges, emissions and cross-chain support shutting down across nine other networks.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Velodrome and Aerodrome will merge into a unified DEX 'Aero' on Oct 21 launching on OP mainnet and Ink, with xVELO holders required to bridge back to OP by Oct 15 and gauges, emissions and cross-chain support shutting down across nine other networks.

updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：AERO 与 VELO 代币将合并为单一 AERO，收入约 94.5% 分配给 AERO 持有者、5.5% 给 VELO 持有者；Aero 上线网络覆盖 Base、以太坊主网、OP、Arc、Ink，并新增 Robinhood Chain 与 Arbitrum；AERO 和 VELODROME 价格 24 小时涨超 16%。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: AERO and VELO tokens will consolidate into a single AERO token, with revenue split roughly 94.5% to AERO holders and 5.5% to VELO holders; Aero launch coverage includes Base, Ethereum mainnet, OP, Arc, Ink, plus Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum; AERO and VELODROME rose over 16% in 24 hours.

updates.current_state_en: Velodrome and Aerodrome are set to merge into unified cross-chain DEX Aero on October 21; AERO and VELO tokens will consolidate into a single AERO with revenue split roughly 94.5%/5.5%; launch coverage includes Base, Ethereum mainnet, OP, Arc, Ink, Robinhood Chain, and Arbitrum; community and exchanges are migrating to Aero, with token prices surging.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Aerodrome and Velodrome will merge into a single cross-chain DEX called Aero on October 21, consolidating AERO and VELO into one AERO token with revenue split roughly 94.5% to AERO and 5.5% to VELO holders, sending both tokens up over 16%.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Aerodrome and Velodrome will merge into a single cross-chain DEX called Aero on October 21, consolidating AERO and VELO into one AERO token with revenue split roughly 94.5% to AERO and 5.5% to VELO holders, sending both tokens up over 16%.
updates.background_zh: Aerodrome Finance 是部署在 Base 网络上的 DEX 与自动做市商，其自我描述为融合了 Curve、Convex 与 Uniswap 的特点；Velodrome 则定位为 Optimism 网络上的核心流动性枢纽。这两个采用相似 ve(3,3) 治理模式的协议如今正以 Aero 之名完成整合。
updates.background_en: Aerodrome Finance is a DEX and automated market maker on the Base network that describes itself as combining elements of Curve, Convex and Uniswap. Velodrome is positioned as the central liquidity hub on the Optimism network. The two protocols, which share a common ve(3,3) style governance model, are now consolidating under the Aero name.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要在代币供给与流动性两端：AERO 与 VELO 持有者面临并轨为单一 AERO 代币、并适用固定收入分配比例，而原本集中在 Base 与 Optimism 的流动性激励与交易活动可能随资金池迁移而重配。市场同时关注上线 AERO、VELO 的交易平台如何处置代币切换，以及跨链 DEX 在 Layer 2 交易量上的竞争格局。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through token supply and liquidity: AERO and VELO holders face a consolidation into one AERO token with a fixed revenue-sharing split, while liquidity incentives and trading activity concentrated on Base and Optimism may shift as pools migrate to the merged venue. Attention also falls on how venues listing AERO and VELO handle the switch and on cross-chain DEX competition for Layer 2 volume.
